packageRules.description: Forgejo requires sequential major upgrades to execute database schema migrations
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Forgejo Upgrade Requirement**: Upstream requires upgrading major releases sequentially (e.g. 7.x → 8.x → 9.x) to execute database migrations in sequence. Do not skip major versions.

packageRules.description: Immich requires review of breaking changes and migration checkpoints
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Immich Upgrade Requirement**: Review the [Immich Release Notes](https://github.com/immich-app/immich/releases) for breaking changes and verify all migration jobs are completed before proceeding to subsequent releases.

packageRules.description: Longhorn requires sequential minor version upgrades
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Longhorn Upgrade Requirement**: Upstream requires sequential minor version upgrades (e.g. 1.10 → 1.11 → 1.12). Skipping minor versions is unsupported. Note: volume engine upgrades are automated via `concurrentAutomaticEngineUpgradePerNodeLimit`.

packageRules.description: cert-manager recommends sequential minor version upgrades for CRD/webhook alignment
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **cert-manager Upgrade Requirement**: Upstream recommends upgrading minor versions sequentially (e.g. 1.15 → 1.16 → 1.17) to ensure CRD schema and webhook compatibility.

packageRules.description: CloudNativePG operand major upgrades trigger automated in-place pg_upgrade
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **CloudNativePG Upgrade**: Minor versions roll the instance pod. A major PostgreSQL version triggers CloudNativePG's offline in-place `pg_upgrade` Job on sync, with the whole cluster down until it finishes. Before merging a major: take an on-demand CNPG `volumeSnapshot` `Backup` and confirm the extensions and the target image's Debian release match the current one. If the upgrade Job fails, revert this PR. After it succeeds, refresh statistics and take a new backup. See [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#1-automated-major-database-upgrades-cloudnativepg).

packageRules.description: cloudnative-vectorchord tags are <pg major>.<pg minor>-<VectorChord semver>; docker versioning would treat the VectorChord version as a fixed compatibility suffix and never propose an update
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **cloudnative-vectorchord**: Renovate labels VectorChord version changes as patch updates; check the Immich release notes for the supported VectorChord range. The tags do not name the Debian release. On a PostgreSQL major upgrade, compare the `org.opencontainers.image.base.name` label of the new image with the current one: `pg_upgrade` does not support a Debian release change. On a minor update, a Debian release change is safe (see [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#debian-release-moves)).

packageRules.description: Debian release moves of CloudNativePG operand images keep the PostgreSQL version and never run pg_upgrade
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **CloudNativePG Debian Release Move**: Only the image's Debian release changes; the PostgreSQL version stays the same, so the operator rolls each instance pod and no `pg_upgrade` runs. Every cluster uses CNPG's default `C` collation, which does not depend on glibc, so no reindex is needed. See [docs/upgrades.md](docs/upgrades.md#debian-release-moves).

packageRules.description: MariaDB operand upgrades: separate PRs per major, release-notes reminder
prBodyNotes: ℹ️ **MariaDB Upgrade**: Merging is the whole procedure (docs/upgrades.md §8): the Supernote sync first takes a pre-upgrade volume snapshot (PreSync `PhysicalBackup` hook, which fails the sync if the snapshot fails), the instance shuts down cleanly, and the entrypoint runs `mariadb-upgrade` (`mariadbAutoUpgradeEnabled`). Review the [MariaDB release notes](https://mariadb.com/docs/release-notes) for removed or changed options first; MariaDB cannot be downgraded in place.

packageRules.description: Re-vendor the patched DocumentDB operator chart on version bumps so the PR contains the complete tree
Refresh the hass-oidc-auth zip sha256 on version bumps so the PR never ships a stale hash
Group every Kubernetes version pin (PSA labels, kind node image, documentation, e2e hook comments) into one PR
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Cluster Upgrade Ordering**: merge only after the Talos nodes run the new Kubernetes minor, so the `managedNamespaceMetadata` PSA labels never reference a version newer than the API server. The e2e suite also requires a local kind CLI new enough to pull the new `kindest/node` image (see docs/upgrades.md).
